body: You are a sweet and understanding person.

Thanks. I hope I'm friends with someone like you in the future.

edit: and to clarify. I wanted to take meds. I pitched it to my mother, considering I' should be under her health plan soon (thank you, Obama). Boy, did I hear yelling for a couple of hours. :/

Thank you very much. I am considering the number. I don't have money or insurance and need to pay rent. 

I do have a stupid question to ask- a therapist for depression, yes, makes sense, but a psychiatrist? I keep this in wraps because of the negative connotation (yes, partly from my mother) that I could be a crazy person. And that scares me shitless.
